prompt:
Create a high fidelity desktop web application UI comp, edge to edge, crisp readable text, no browser frame or device. Product: Bakiano / Madrid Delivery Sim, a local operations lab for inspecting queue-driven delivery agents and optional Google Cloud AI decisions. User's pinned direction: Linear-style dark ops console, calm dense graphite surfaces, single muted teal accent for selection and routes, amber/red only for warning/error states. IBM Plex Sans UI paired with IBM Plex Mono technical IDs. No purple, gradients, decorative hero, huge headlines or nested cards.

This option is AGENT-LED. A narrow left navigation contains Delivery, Restaurants, Inventory, Health, Traces, Architecture and Madrid baseline. Compact top title 'Delivery operations', 'Local simulation', 'Start simulation'. Slim summary row with 'Orders/min 0.6', 'On-time 91%', 'Cost / delivery —' caption 'Not recorded', 'p95 decision —' caption 'No model calls'. Label the content 'Synthetic session'. A broad central agent roster leads the page with role/status filters, compact table rows of courier, dispatcher, inventory and fulfillment agents, task labels and tiny throughput sparklines. Selected row 'Lucia Mora · courier:01' shows 'Delivering' and 'Basket B-042'. A substantial dark synthetic city-grid map sits to the right, teal routes and small shaped markers, no real Madrid neighborhood claims. A full-width lower evidence timeline follows the selected agent through 'Lease acquired', 'Route accepted', 'Parcel delivered', each with source event and recorded time. Signature: selecting the row connects route and evidence. Complete screen with purposeful footer 'Local rules · no provider calls'. Compose for a 1440×960 laptop, with all work areas distinct and highly readable.
